description: Progressive disclosure skills: lets an agent open one section of a skill's bundled library mid-turn, by name, instead of carrying the whole document in every prompt. You choose which sections each agent may open; anything else is refused. Offered only to agents that have such a skill — otherwise it is not present at all.

tool_definition.name: TDA_SkillLibrary
tool_definition.description: Reads a section of your skill's on-demand LIBRARY. Your always-resident skill content is the lean root; the full reference corpus is fetched section-by-section through this tool. Call 'read' with the section's anchor (the anchor index is in your skill context) BEFORE answering from that section's domain — never answer from memory what the library holds. Call 'list_sections' to re-list the available anchors.

action.description: 'read' (fetch one section by anchor) | 'list_sections' (the anchor index)

anchor.description: The section anchor to read, exactly as listed in the anchor index (e.g. 'search', 'teradata/modules/domain/01-keymap'). Required for 'read'.

skill_id.description: Which progressive skill's library to read. Omit when exactly one progressive skill is active — it is inferred.
